fields.name: unused_head
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: always 0 in every save image; slot table starts at 0x0010

fields.name: slots_0_2
fields.meaning: Three player save files (files 1-3 on the load screen), 0x23D bytes each at 0x0010, 0x024D, 0x048A; same record layout as below. Empty (all zero) in the verified save
fields.evidence: ROM slot table at bank 0x3A offset 0x20; file-screen reader checks only slots 0-2 (a000:02e6); empty here

fields.name: slot_3_suspend
fields.meaning: Suspend file. The rows below give the record layout using this copy
fields.evidence: suspend command loads slot 4 then writes slot 3 (a000:472f); written by answering the suspend prompt with yes

fields.name: slot_4_checkpoint
fields.meaning: Automatic checkpoint record, rewritten by the game itself at story events and area changes. Never shown to the player; suspend copies it into slot 3
fields.evidence: two routines save slot 4 before loading a new map (9000:0a00, f000:5075); written during a story scene with no menu

fields.name: backups
fields.meaning: Backup copy of slots 0-4 (slot n at 0x0B41 + n*0x23D). Written right after the main copy; read only if the main copy fails its check
fields.evidence: writer writes main then backup (a000:0088); loader tries main then backup (a000:0176); byte-identical to main copies

fields.name: last_slot
fields.meaning: Number of the slot written most recently (0-4). Used at power-on to preload the last file when files 1-3 exist
fields.evidence: save routine stores it (a000:031f), title routine reads it (a000:0337); checkpoint image = 4, suspend image = 3

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: always 0; no code address beyond 0x1673

fields.name: rec+0x000 magic
fields.meaning: Text "WscActRpgChopperAdventure2003^^;" marks a valid record; written last, so an interrupted save stays invalid
fields.evidence: compared to the same text in ROM on load (a000:0244)

fields.name: rec+0x020 checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the record bytes from rec+0x22 to rec+0x23C (0x21B bytes)
fields.evidence: recomputed 0xB0B3, matches all six stored records (2 in the checkpoint image, 4 in the suspend image)

fields.name: rec+0x022 play_time
fields.meaning: Play time in frames (75 per second), capped just under 99:59:59; 14952 frames = 3 min 19 s
fields.evidence: frame interrupt adds 1 each frame (f000:8bfb), new game clears; rises with play

fields.name: rec+0x026 file_icons
fields.meaning: Six progress marks on the file screen: chapter-table row bits (chapters 0-10), one more mark lighting up as the story advances; exact pictures not identified
fields.evidence: computed at save time (f000:6556) from chapter and one event flag; both ROM tables decoded; 0 here

fields.name: rec+0x027 level_copy
fields.meaning: Chopper level, copy for the file screen
fields.evidence: header pack code (a000:0138); load screen shows Lv1; value 1

fields.name: rec+0x028 hp_copy
fields.meaning: Current HP, copy for the file screen
fields.evidence: header pack code; load screen shows HP 50/50; value 50

fields.name: rec+0x02a max_hp_copy
fields.meaning: Maximum HP, copy for the file screen
fields.evidence: header pack code; value 50

fields.name: rec+0x02c money_copy
fields.meaning: Money (berries), copy for the file screen
fields.evidence: header pack code; value 100 = menu screen 100 berries

fields.name: rec+0x030 base_max_hp
fields.meaning: Base maximum HP: grown at level-up (cap 9999) and copied to max HP by the stat recalc
fields.evidence: level-up adds growth (a000:9360), recalc copies to max HP (a000:8f83); value 50

fields.name: rec+0x032 level
fields.meaning: Chopper level (cap 99)
fields.evidence: new-game init 1 (a000:8ad0); menu and battle screens show Lv 1

fields.name: rec+0x033 trained_stats
fields.meaning: Trained stamina, strength, speed (体力, 筋力, 速さ); raised at level-up within caps
fields.evidence: menu shows 5/5/5; level-up increments them (a000:931E); recalc reads them as inputs

fields.name: rec+0x036 status_flags
fields.meaning: Status bits; bit 0 set/cleared by one routine
fields.evidence: new-game clears; single setter routine

fields.name: rec+0x038 hp
fields.meaning: Current HP
fields.evidence: battle damage (live HP 30/28/25 while saved HP stays 50); add/sub routines clamp 0..max (a000:91cf/91ec)

fields.name: rec+0x03a counters_a
fields.meaning: Two counter bytes, cleared at new game
fields.evidence: new-game clears; all zero here

fields.name: rec+0x03c form_mode
fields.meaning: Battle-form index selecting a stat multiplier in the recalc
fields.evidence: recalc scales all stats by a ROM table entry for this index when enabled (a000:9085)

fields.name: rec+0x03d counter_43d
fields.meaning: One counter byte, cleared at new game
fields.evidence: new-game clears; zero here

fields.name: rec+0x03e counters_b
fields.meaning: Two counter words, cleared at new game
fields.evidence: new-game clears; zero here

fields.name: rec+0x042 form_enable
fields.meaning: Nonzero enables the form stat multiplier
fields.evidence: recalc tests it (a000:907D); zero here

fields.name: rec+0x044 counter_444
fields.meaning: One counter word, cleared at new game
fields.evidence: new-game clears; zero here

fields.name: rec+0x046 max_hp
fields.meaning: Maximum HP (recomputed from base max HP)
fields.evidence: screens show HP x/50; recalc writes it; header copies it

fields.name: rec+0x048 effective_stats
fields.meaning: Effective stamina, strength, speed = trained stats plus equipment/food bonuses, recomputed
fields.evidence: recalc writes them from trained stats + effect block (a000:8f83); all 5 here

fields.name: rec+0x04b rp
fields.meaning: RP gauge, 0-100
fields.evidence: add/sub routines clamp 0..100 (a000:9203/921b); HUD and menu show the RP bar

fields.name: rec+0x04c exp
fields.meaning: Experience points; next level at level*20+100, then reset
fields.evidence: add routine thresholds and triggers level-up (a000:92c2); menu shows EXP bar

fields.name: rec+0x04e money
fields.meaning: Money (berries)
fields.evidence: menu screen 100 berries; new-game init 100; header copies it

fields.name: rec+0x052 words_452
fields.meaning: Two words cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: new-game clears; code references exist but role unclear

fields.name: rec+0x056 items
fields.meaning: 32 item entries of 3 bytes: item id (0xFF = empty), count, 1 byte not set by the game
fields.evidence: new-game loop sets 32 x (FF,00) (a000:8ad0); all empty here; item menu code reads this block

fields.name: rec+0x0b6 item_count
fields.meaning: Cleared at new game; probably the number of items held
fields.evidence: new-game clears; item code reads it

fields.name: rec+0x0b8 equipment
fields.meaning: Twelve bytes set to 0xFF (empty) at new game, in groups of 4,4,4; probably equipped items
fields.evidence: new-game inits; equipment code reads this block

fields.name: rec+0x0c4 pad_4c4
fields.meaning: Word cleared at new game; no code reference found
fields.evidence: no reference in ROM search; zero here

fields.name: rec+0x0c6 bonus_stamina_value
fields.meaning: Stamina bonus added to effective stats when its flag is set
fields.evidence: recalc adds it (a000:8FAB)

fields.name: rec+0x0c7 unk_4c7
fields.meaning: Byte cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: zero here; no decoded use

fields.name: rec+0x0c8 bonus_stamina_flag
fields.meaning: Nonzero applies the stamina bonus
fields.evidence: recalc tests it (a000:8FA3)

fields.name: rec+0x0ca bonus_strength_value
fields.meaning: Strength bonus added to effective stats when its flag is set
fields.evidence: recalc adds it (a000:8FBC)

fields.name: rec+0x0cb unk_4cb
fields.meaning: Byte cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: zero here; no decoded use

fields.name: rec+0x0cc bonus_strength_flag
fields.meaning: Nonzero applies the strength bonus
fields.evidence: recalc tests it (a000:8FB4)

fields.name: rec+0x0ce bonus_speed_value
fields.meaning: Speed bonus added to effective stats when its flag is set
fields.evidence: recalc adds it (a000:8FCD)

fields.name: rec+0x0cf unk_4cf
fields.meaning: Byte cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: zero here; no decoded use

fields.name: rec+0x0d0 bonus_speed_flag
fields.meaning: Nonzero applies the speed bonus
fields.evidence: recalc tests it (a000:8FC5)

fields.name: rec+0x0d2 bonus_3_flags
fields.meaning: Bits 0/1/2 add +3 to effective stamina/strength/speed; cleared on floor changes
fields.evidence: recalc tests bits (a000:8FD6); floor-descend clears it (f000:5020)

fields.name: rec+0x0d4 unk_4d4
fields.meaning: Two words cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: zero here; no decoded use

fields.name: rec+0x0d8 bonus_indexed_flag
fields.meaning: Nonzero adds +1 to one effective stat picked by the target byte
fields.evidence: recalc tests it (a000:9003)

fields.name: rec+0x0da unk_4da
fields.meaning: Two words cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: zero here; no decoded use

fields.name: rec+0x0de bonus5_stamina_flag
fields.meaning: Nonzero adds +5 to effective stamina
fields.evidence: recalc tests it (a000:9019)

fields.name: rec+0x0e0 bonus5_strength_flag
fields.meaning: Nonzero adds +5 to effective strength
fields.evidence: recalc tests it (a000:9027)

fields.name: rec+0x0e2 bonus5_speed_flag
fields.meaning: Nonzero adds +5 to effective speed
fields.evidence: recalc tests it (a000:9035)

fields.name: rec+0x0e4 unk_4e4
fields.meaning: Two words cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: zero here; no decoded use

fields.name: rec+0x0e8 scale34_flag
fields.meaning: Nonzero scales all effective stats to 3/4
fields.evidence: recalc multiplies and shifts (a000:904B)

fields.name: rec+0x0ea bonus_indexed_target
fields.meaning: Which effective stat the indexed +1 hits (0-2)
fields.evidence: recalc indexes with it (a000:9013)

fields.name: rec+0x0eb descend_flags
fields.meaning: Floor-change flags: bit 1 blocks the automatic step down; high nibble picks the entry direction in one area
fields.evidence: floor-descend code tests bit 1 and maps the nibble (f000:5099)

fields.name: rec+0x0ed resume_marker
fields.meaning: Resume marker, 0xFF; on loading a suspend file it is copied (FF to 0) into a work variable
fields.evidence: new-game sets FF; resume copies it (f000:6a8a)

fields.name: rec+0x0ee pad_4ee
fields.meaning: Not set by the game (left-over memory value)
fields.evidence: no writer at new game; value 0xAD

fields.name: rec+0x0ef area
fields.meaning: Current area number (0 = the starting grassland)
fields.evidence: passed to the map loader with the floor (9000:0A0E); new game 0; load screen shows the grassland

fields.name: rec+0x0f1 floor
fields.meaning: Current floor number (2 = second floor)
fields.evidence: passed to the map loader; floor-descend increments it; HUD shows F 2

fields.name: rec+0x0f3 entry_dir
fields.meaning: Entry direction, 0-3, picked when stepping to a new floor
fields.evidence: floor-descend sets 0-3 from flags (f000:50CC)

fields.name: rec+0x0f4 unk_4f4
fields.meaning: Three bytes set to 0xFF at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: new-game inits

fields.name: rec+0x0f7 unk_4f7
fields.meaning: Two words cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: new-game clears; zero here

fields.name: rec+0x0fb unk_4fb
fields.meaning: 44 bytes cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: new-game clears; zero here; a few code readers

fields.name: rec+0x127 play_time2
fields.meaning: Play time in frames (same value as the header copy)
fields.evidence: frame interrupt; rises with play

fields.name: rec+0x12b storage
fields.meaning: 100 entries of 2 bytes (id 0xFF = empty, count); probably item storage
fields.evidence: new-game loop sets 100 x (FF,00) (f000:5db9); empty here

fields.name: rec+0x1f3 unk_5f3
fields.meaning: Two words cleared at new game; meaning not identified
fields.evidence: new-game clears; a few code readers

fields.name: rec+0x1f7 pad_5f7
fields.meaning: Not set by the game (left-over memory value 0xAD)
fields.evidence: no writer at new game

fields.name: rec+0x1fb event_flags
fields.meaning: 256 story event flags, one bit each (flags 102-104 set here, one of them during the checkpoint story scene)
fields.evidence: new game clears; flag 104 set during a story scene; tested by f000:3a26

fields.name: rec+0x21b story_word
fields.meaning: Story progress word; 1 here
fields.evidence: new game clears

fields.name: rec+0x21d chapter
fields.meaning: Story chapter number 0-10, picks the file-screen marks row
fields.evidence: indexes the chapter tables at save time (f000:656E); tables hold 11 rows; 0 here

fields.name: rec+0x21f story_vars
fields.meaning: Other story variables (one set to 1 by the checkpoint story scene)
fields.evidence: new game clears; diff across the story scene

fields.name: rec+0x23b text_speed
fields.meaning: Message speed setting (0 slow, 1 normal, 2 fast)
fields.evidence: settings menu stores choice minus 20 and shows a sample (a000:4707); new game 1; screen shows normal with value 1

values.value: game uses cartridge SRAM only; EEPROM stays blank
